list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A halogenido-bridged dimer with two seven-coordinate yttrium centers, each bearing a pentamethylcyclopentadienyl and a tetramethylaluminato ligand.

synthesis.procedure: Under air- and moisture-excluding conditions, add SiMe3Br in n-hexane to (C5Me5)Y(AlMe4)2 in n-hexane; heat at 70 °C for 1 h and cool. Crystals form from the mother liquor at ambient temperature; wash repeatedly with n-hexane.
synthesis.temperature: 70 °C for reaction; ambient temperature for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystallization from the n-hexane mother liquor followed by repeated n-hexane washing.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Two symmetry-related La3Al2 subunits assemble into a discrete La6Al4 cluster. Bridging chlorido ligands and interconnected aluminato ligands link the metal centers; the lanthanum centers are formally eight-coordinate.

synthesis.procedure: Treat (C5Me4SiMe3)La(AlMe4)2 with 1.3 equivalents of trimethylsilyl chloride for tetramethylaluminato/chlorido exchange. Colorless crystals form on standing in n-hexane at ambient temperature. The converted Markdown does not reliably preserve the compound-specific masses or yield.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Colorless crystals obtained from a resting n-hexane solution.

Experimental Section, 3*-LaOTf entry

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Three lanthanum centers form a 12-membered ring of La–O–S–O units through three bridging triflates, capped by two triply bridging triflates. Peripheral cyclopentadienyl and THF ligands and one tetramethylaluminato ligand complete the coordination environment.

synthesis.procedure: Treat (C5Me5)La(AlMe4)2 with trimethylsilyl triflate by the lanthanum halogenido-transfer procedure; crystals for XRD were obtained from THF. The main-text description notes decomposition in THF over time unless kept at lower temperature.
synthesis.temperature: Low temperature for storage/crystallization; exact value not assigned from this entry

Experimental Section, yttrium methylidene route A and 4*-YBr entry

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Three yttrium centers are joined by three doubly bridging bromides, one triply bridging bromide, and a triply bridging methylidene protruding from the Y3Br3 plane. Cyclopentadienyl and THF ligands complete distorted pseudo-octahedral coordination environments.

synthesis.procedure: Suspend 1*-YBr in toluene, add THF, shake and filter. Let stand at ambient temperature for 3–4 days; concentrate the yellow-orange mixture and cool to crystallize.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter, concentrate, and store at −40 °C to obtain crystals.

Experimental Section, lanthanum methylidene general procedure and 4*-LaBr entry

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Three lanthanum centers are linked by three doubly bridging and one triply bridging bromido ligands and a triply bridging methylidene. The methylidene projects from the La3Br3 plane; each lanthanum also binds cyclopentadienyl and THF ligands.

synthesis.procedure: Suspend 2*-LaBr in toluene, add THF, shake and filter. After standing at ambient temperature for 3–4 days, concentrate and store at −40 °C to crystallize the product.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter, concentrate, and store at −40 °C; light-yellow crystals.
